;Armed conflicts and attacks
*Four [[Iraq|Iraqi]] soldiers are wounded when mortar shells strike [[Balad Air Base]], {{convert|40|mi|km}} north of [[Baghdad]], which houses [[United States|U.S.]] military personnel. The mortars struck the runway inside the base. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-iraq-security-base/mortar-bombs-strike-iraqi-military-base-of-balad-four-wounded-military-sources-idUSKBN1ZB0I0?il=0 (Reuters)]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[2020 Taal Volcano eruption]]
** The [[Taal Volcano]] in southern [[Luzon]], [[Philippines]], spews an [[Volcanic ash|ash plume]] that measures approximately {{convert|10|to|15|km|mi}}. The [[Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology]] designates a "level 4" alert level, indicating "an imminent hazardous eruption". [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2020/jan/13/philippines-lava-gushes-from-taal-volcano-as-alert-level-raised (''The Guardian'')]
*The government of the Canadian province of [[Ontario]] apologizes for issuing a false alert about an incident at a [[nuclear plant]] near [[Toronto]] and blames a training exercise mistake. Angry local mayors demand an inquiry, saying the emergency message about the ageing [[Pickering Nuclear Generating Station]] has caused unnecessary distress. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-canada-nuclear/canada-province-says-sorry-after-training-mistake-sparks-false-nuclear-alert-idUSKBN1ZB0C8?il=0 (Reuters)]

;International relations
*[[Japan–Saudi Arabia relations]]
**Japanese PM [[Shinzō Abe]] arrives in Saudi Arabia in his first visit to the Middle East, where he expects to mediate between the United States and Iran amid heightening tensions. [https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2020/01/12/national/politics-diplomacy/abe-meets-saudi-king-salman-calls-cooperation-stabilize-middle-east-talks-foreign-minister/ (''The Japan Times'')]

;Politics and elections
*[[Ukraine International Airlines Flight 752]], [[2019–20 Iranian protests]]
**Protests continue for a second day despite a large deployment of security forces. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/amp/world-middle-east-51081833 (BBC News)]
*[[The Gambia]] warns ousted leader [[Yahya Jammeh]] not to return to the country, saying his safety cannot be guaranteed if he returns without permission, a government spokesman says. A spokesman for Jammeh's party says he could arrive back at any time from exile in [[Equatorial Guinea]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-51082371 (BBC News)]
*[[2019 Malta political crisis]]
**[[Robert Abela]] wins the [[Partit Laburista]] leadership election, succeeding [[Joseph Muscat]] as [[Prime Minister of Malta|Prime Minister]] after Muscat's resignation. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-51080574 (BBC News)] [https://edition.cnn.com/2020/01/12/europe/malta-robert-abela-prime-minister-intl/index.html (CNN International)]

;Science and technology
*[[Chinese espionage in the United States]]
**The [[United States Department of the Interior|U.S. Department of the Interior]] halts its civilian [[Unmanned aerial vehicle|drone]] program indefinitely out of concerns that [[China]] manufactured the fleet via the [[DJI (company)|SZ DJI Technology Company]] for espionage. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-drones/trump-to-halt-civilian-drone-program-over-china-tech-concerns-ft-idUSKBN1ZB0MU (Reuters)]
